landing.testimonialsSubtitle: Join thousands of educators who transformed their teaching
landing.testimonial1Text: Afaq Tech saved me hours of preparation time. The AI generates lesson plans that are detailed, creative, and perfectly aligned with the curriculum.
landing.testimonial2Text: The academy section is comprehensive and well-organized. My students love the structured approach and I love how easy it is to find materials.
landing.testimonial3Text: As a school administrator, the multi-teacher accounts and reporting features have been a game-changer for our institution.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start free, upgrade when you're ready
landing.faq1A: Yes! The free plan includes 5 lesson plans per month and basic academy access. No credit card is required to sign up. You can upgrade to Pro or School anytime for unlimited access.
landing.faq2Q: How does the AI lesson plan generator work?
landing.faq2A: Our AI uses advanced language models trained on educational content. Simply select your subject and curriculum, describe the lesson you need, and the AI generates a complete, professional lesson plan in under 30 seconds.
landing.faq3Q: Does the platform support all curricula?
landing.faq3A: We currently support major Arabic curricula including Saudi, Egyptian, UAE, and more. We're constantly adding new curricula and educational materials. If your curriculum isn't available yet, let us know!
landing.faq4Q: Can I use the platform without registering?
landing.faq4A: You can browse the academy and view available subjects and grades without an account. However, to create lesson plans and access the AI assistant, you'll need a free account.
landing.faq5A: You can reach our support team through the contact page, email, or WhatsApp. Pro users get priority support with faster response times. School plan users get a dedicated support manager.
